task.description:
Write test spec for DSL-03 (Error Recovery — SHOULD) as tests/specs/DSL-03.md. The test spec must cover:
1. Acceptance test from the requirement: an input with three distinct syntax errors yields a report with three ParseError entries.
2. Edge cases: multiple errors across different grammar productions (e.g., missing operand + unexpected token + unmatched paren)
3. Valid expressions still parse to .ok (regression)
4. Mixed lexer + parser errors (e.g., invalid number literal + missing operator)
5. Error after recovery (parser continues past first error and finds more)

All tests are unit-level (no DB, no I/O). Test file: tests/unit/expr_error_recovery_test.zig.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/DSL-03.md exists with at least 5 test cases
Each test case has Given/When/Then format
Acceptance test maps to the DSL-03 requirement criterion
All test cases can be run via zig build test
